worldcombat.skill.meteorbeam.summary: Gather shards of star into your body to raise Special Attack, then hurl a meteor on a ballistic arc. It clears cover, the body it strikes takes the heavy hit, the ring around the landing point is splashed and shoved, and the ground is left as a scorched crater for a while. It always takes these two beats.
worldcombat.skill.meteorbeam.use.0: Drop it over cover onto whoever hides behind it
worldcombat.skill.meteorbeam.use.1: Raise your Special Attack, then spend it
worldcombat.skill.meteorbeam.use.2: Crack open the whole landing ring
worldcombat.skill.meteorbeam.description: The body struck head-on takes about %1$s special damage, and every other enemy in the landing ring takes about %2$s special damage.
Gathering takes %1$s of standing still; when it completes Special Attack rises by %2$s stages, and that gain stays after the throw.
The meteor is thrown at %1$s blocks per tick on a ballistic arc; the landing radius is %2$s blocks and its flight hitbox radius is %3$s blocks.
Enemies hit within the landing radius are shoved %1$s blocks; the scorched ground grows back after %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.meteorbeam.stance.deep: Deep space: the gather grants one more Special Attack stage (+2 total) and a larger landing, at the cost of a longer gather, a lighter direct hit and a longer cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.meteorbeam.stance.ligh: Quick throw: a shorter gather and a heavier direct hit, but only +1 Special Attack stage and a smaller landing.
worldcombat.skill.meteorbeam.timing: Cast within %1$s blocks; after %2$s it spends %4$s PP, recovers for %3$s, and cools down for %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.meteorbeam.growth.0: From level %1$s the direct hit steps up with level.
worldcombat.skill.meteorbeam.growth.1: From level %1$s the direct hit and the splash step up again.
worldcombat.skill.meteorbeam.growth.2: At level %1$s the cooldown drops to %2$s.
On (deep space): the gather grants one more Special Attack stage (+2 total) and a larger landing, but the gather is x1.3 longer, the direct hit is x0.85 and the cooldown costs 5 ticks more. Off: a shorter gather and a heavier throw, but only +1 Special Attack stage and a smaller landing.
Beyond this distance the companion closes in first instead of starting the gather; higher means it throws from further away.
Inside this distance the companion lowers its firing priority so it does not stand gathering within reach; 0 means it throws even point-blank.
On: raises priority while its Special Attack is below +4 stages, so it banks this stage first; off: it does not chase the buff specifically.
On: prefers firing when blocks stand between it and the target, because the meteor arcs over cover; off: cover is ignored and it ranks by ordinary ranged priority.
